div.p: Cyberpunk 2077, Hogwarts Legacy, Spider-Man — the ones I keep going back to.
Code with no acceptance criteria, written to find out whether an idea holds.
From a requirement and a budget to a machine that boots — and glows.
Hours with the manual open, every piece where the page says. Worth every minute.
The game that taught me how to concentrate.
Hard to do every day. A joy when I do. Best of all when it is for someone else.
I never understood it. Then I started One Piece.
Model cars, and the collectibles that earn a place beside them.
